summary: MeshCentral is a self-hosted web application designed for remote device management and control across local networks and the internet. It provides administrators with a centralised interface to interact with managed computers. The platform is built using Node.js and distributed under the Apache-2.0 licence.
goodFor: System administrators and IT support teams who require a dedicated, self-hosted solution for managing multiple remote endpoints without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: Self-hosting a remote management infrastructure introduces significant security responsibilities, as any misconfiguration could expose managed endpoints to unauthorised access.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and persistent storage to maintain configuration data and device state.
